Add the ketchup, Kewpie mayo, chili oil, Buldak sauce, seasoning powder, and chopped green onions. Stir until the cheese melts and everything is well combined. Pour in the heavy cream and mix until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Add the half-cooked Buldak noodles and toss until every strand is coated in the rich, cheesy sauce. Top with cooked dumplings and sliced sausage. Finish with an extra drizzle of chili oil and more chopped green onions. Serve hot and enjoy! #r#ramenb#buldakr#Recipec#cookspicy
